# ${module_id} - Integration and release assembly

## Module contract and selection

@@SELECTION@@

Combine accepted inputs in a declared order, prove the combined coordinate, optionally promote it,
retain rollback state when needed, and retire only release-level state that is safe to close.

## Public interface and compatibility boundary

ROOT-accepted tips + separate integration card -> verified integrated coordinate, rollback/retirement state. Concrete values and return targets belong to the owning step's configured instance. Private changes do not alter public semantics; update actual consumers for a real contract change.

## Rules, process, recipe actions, and allowed variations

P01–P15 own shared rules. Semantic choices in recipe verbs remain ROOT decisions; test_root only authors declared lane-local contracts. Workers mechanically execute supplied choices and return any missing meaning. Reviewer findings remain open within assigned boundaries. Each governing card cites all actions; member cards cite only their ordered subset. Parameters may select bounded source/test paths and optional profiles, never weaken acceptance or change authority.

| Order | Recipe action ID | Project-specific action/process | Allowed parameterization | Decision owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M06-A1 | Revalidate every accepted input and verdict before mutation. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 2 | M06-A2 | Verify destination state/cleanliness and record a rollback base when rollback is required. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 3 | M06-A3 | Integrate inputs serially in the declared order; one owner resolves conflicts without changing scope. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 4 | M06-A4 | Inspect the combined diff/manifest and run only checks implicated by integration seams; reuse pre-join PASS credit when the join leaves a check's declared inputs unchanged. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 5 | M06-A5 | Publish the integrated coordinate and required post-join results. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 6 | M06-A6 | If promotion is selected, advance only the accepted coordinate and read back the destination state. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 7 | M06-A7 | Preserve required rollback state and consumed acceptance results before retiring temporary state. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 8 | M06-A8 | Retire only clean, terminal, unclaimed lanes/resources; failed archival remains visible for recovery. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |

- A mechanically resolvable conflict, destination mismatch, or interrupted join remains inside the exact
  M06 operation and resumes only at its first unresolved action while accepted input behavior stays intact.
- Only a result showing that required post-join product behavior or contract correctness failed/remains genuinely
  undecidable goes to M05, then to the owning accepted input only if its dependency is invalidated; do not
  broadly reopen all deliverables.
- Promotion/deployment/readback mismatch is an operation-boundary failure when accepted source behavior
  remains intact. Stop and report the verified contradiction; never guess, promote another tip, or enter
  product repair without a failed or undecidable product criterion.
- Archive or retirement support failure leaves that exact state visible and blocks only its direct
  retirement/reuse consumer.
- No promotion scope means stop after accepted integration; do not create a dummy release action.
- A Series 1 M06 occurrence is a separate minimal integration/readback instance for the repaired step
  output and its changed-input map. It exits to the ROOT-selected progress-bound step's Series 2 entry
  and never advances the repaired step's normal successor path as a substitute for that handoff.
